defects.cause: Replacing tzinfo reinterprets the wall-clock value rather than converting the original UTC-offset instant.
defects.consequence: A token expired at 10:00Z is treated as active until 12:00Z; negative offsets can also expire valid tokens early.
defects.boundary: parse_expiration -> is_expired token authorization time boundary
defects.proof: The oracle checks positive and negative offsets, exact expiry equality and naive rejection. Head fails; base/control pass.

limitations: Original synthetic Python case; verifies fixture semantics, not either review engine or production integration.
Oracle samples the documented boundary; independent adjudication and broader quality evaluation remain separate.
